summary: Smoke test of Arena.OPS Battlerite Tracker backend + frontend. All 11 tested API endpoints and 6 UI flows pass. ELO math validated (deltas sum to 0.00, winner_team returned).
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT token; GET /api/auth/me works with Bearer token
GET /api/champions returns 25 champions with roles in {Melee, Ranged, Support}
GET /api/seasons returns 2 seeded seasons; POST /api/seasons creates a new one and auto-activates it while deactivating others; POST /api/seasons/{id}/activate switches active flag correctly
POST /api/players creates a player; GET /api/players lists them

POST /api/matches: rejects tied rounds (400 'Rounds cannot be tied'), rejects wrong team size ('Expected 2 players per team for 2v2'), and for a valid 2v2 5-3 win returns winner_team='A' with elo_delta=+20.28 for each A player and -20.28 for each B player (sum=0.00)
GET /api/stats/leaderboard returns 8 players ordered by mmr desc with rank, mmr, wins, losses, winrate
GET /api/stats/player/{id} returns aggregated stats including champions, roles, teammates, opponents, mmr_history
GET /api/stats/matrix returns players list + matrix map
POST /api/matchmaking/balance works for mode=hybrid (win_probability_a=54.7, balance_score=75.04), mode=mmr, and mode=synergy
Frontend login via UI succeeds, dashboard shows totals (21 matches, 128 rounds, 9 players, top ELO 1273) and Top-5 ladder
Navigation to /matches, /leaderboard, /players, /matrix, /matchmaking, /seasons loads with no JS/pageerror events
Player creation via /players page (player-name-input + player-add-btn) - created player appears in the list
Matchmaking flow: 10 mm-player checkboxes found, selected 4, mm-compute enabled, click produced mm-result block
notes: Seasons API uses field name 'active' (not 'is_active') - not a bug, just naming. Match payload uses top-level 'players' array with per-player 'team' field plus team_a_rounds/team_b_rounds - matches backend model. Log-match UI flow and PvP matrix cell rendering were not deeply exercised but pages load cleanly; can be covered in full testing.
